categories.B: NASA source software or algorithm reused

resources.title: NASA/JPL Horizons
resources.implementation: Bundled sampled positions and velocities set the moving gravity sources, date-specific injection states, trajectory predictions, live navigation, Earth range, and signal delay. Raw API responses, parameters, and hashes are included.
resources.qualification: As recorded in the source package.

resources.title: Design and Develop Science Missions
resources.implementation: Adapts the goal-to-requirements workflow and four mission segments. Players choose a science objective, configure the spacecraft and injection service, transmit observations to Earth, and inspect a delivered-science report.
resources.qualification: The listed game mechanisms exist; detailed document trace was not available in the input package.

resources.title: NASA Goddard Mission Design Lab
resources.implementation: The instrument trade table exposes alternative designs with mass, power, data rate, and cost. Choices change the live craft mass, energy consumption, storage, and mission assessment. This is a small educational trade study.
resources.qualification: The listed game mechanisms exist; detailed document trace was not available in the input package.

resources.title: CubeSat 101
resources.implementation: Adapts mission planning, launch accommodation, operational checkout, and data return concepts into wet-mass capacity checks, objective verification, finite onboard storage, and a ground-delivery report. The game spacecraft is not a CubeSat-standard design.
resources.qualification: The listed game mechanisms exist; detailed document trace was not available in the input package.

resources.title: Build It Yourself: A Learning Game About Telescopes
resources.implementation: Adapts its science-first design principle: each objective requires a matching measurement package. An incompatible instrument can still fly, but cannot satisfy the science mission. No source code or art was copied from this game.
resources.qualification: The listed game mechanisms exist; detailed document trace was not available in the input package.

resources.title: Space mission concept development using concept maturity levels
resources.role: Challenge resource used as design guidance
resources.implementation: Informs the distinction between a concept, a checked design, and demonstrated mission performance. The preflight requirements and postflight evidence remain explicit. These checks are not a NASA CML rating or certification.
resources.qualification: The listed game mechanisms exist; detailed document trace was not available in the input package.

resources.title: NASA Image and Video Library / Hubble archives
resources.implementation: Successful flights unlock target-matched archived observations, retaining original image bytes, source URLs, credits, and SHA-256 hashes. They are not observations produced by the simulation.
resources.qualification: As recorded in the source package.

resources.title: General Mission Analysis Tool (GMAT)
resources.implementation: Listed for follow-up engineering studies. GMAT is not bundled, executed, or used as a validation reference in this release.
resources.qualification: As recorded in the source package.

resources.title: NASA Mission Viz
resources.implementation: Linked for mission visualization examples. The game uses its own Canvas projections and does not run Mission Viz code.
resources.qualification: As recorded in the source package.

resources.title: Visualize a Space Mission Using Virtual Reality (2023)
resources.implementation: Background challenge reference. This release has no VR mode.
resources.qualification: As recorded in the source package.

resources.title: Canadian Space Agency: Games and activities
resources.role: Partner learning resource; further study only
resources.implementation: Additional space learning activities. No CSA data are used in the calculations.
resources.qualification: As recorded in the source package.
